_about: who wrote each piece of prose in this repository, and against which
figures. one ledger for every surface, because most of them have nowhere
to put it: a yaml `note:` is a string and an html attribute is an
`author` is one of assistant (written in a session, with a human reading
along), local (drafted by the endpoint through the loop and not yet read
by anybody) or human (typed by hand).
`authored_against` is the figures the sentence was written from, so that a
band crossing under it re-opens the block. see research/verdicts.py.
